headline: 12 contracts catalogued on BNB Chain; 5 USDF-focused contracts and 7 AsterEarn products with 6 audits by PeckShield, Salus, Halborn
short_headline: 12 contracts across BNB Chain; USDF core + ecosystem

findings.text: No block-explorer name-tag search performed; BSC explorer direct fetch blocked by allowlist.
Official deployments doc located at docs.asterdex.com/overview/smart-contracts.md; 12 on-chain addresses catalogued with named roles (tokens, minting contracts, treasury).

6 audit reports sourced from docs.asterdex.com/overview/audit-reports.md: PeckShield audits of asBNB and USDF; Salus audits of asBNB and asCAKE; Halborn audit of USDF & asUSDF; unattributed AsterVault and AsterEarn audits.
No GitHub repo pinned in protocol context; discovery limited to docs and audit URLs.
Protocol operates on BNB Chain only per context; no multi-chain enumeration required.
No factory contracts identified in smart contracts list; all 12 addresses are standalone tokens, minters, or treasury.
Role taxonomy applied: token, minting_contract, treasury contract; all roles assigned per D7 vocabulary.
All 12 admin_addresses entries traced to fetched docs.asterdex.com/overview/smart-contracts.md.

rationale.verdict: Discovery enumerated 12 USDF-core and AsterEarn contract addresses from official documentation on BNB Chain, supported by 6 audit reports. On-chain explorer verification (D1 direct fetch, D4 GitHub) blocked by allowlist; addresses are authoritative from pinned docs URL.

evidence.shows: Protocol landing page describes USDF as a fully collateralized stablecoin backed by crypto assets with delta-neutral hedging strategy.

Official smart contract addresses across BNB Chain, Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum including USDF token (0x5A110fC00474038f6c02E89C707D638602EA44B5), USDF minting contract (0xC271fc70dD9E678ac1AB632f797894fe4BE2C345), asUSDF token/minting, asBTC, asBNB, asCAKE with minting contracts, and Aster Treasury.
6 audit reports listed: AsterVault (2024-09-13), AsterEarn (2024-09-12), asBNB by Salus (2024-12-11), asBNB by PeckShield, USDF by PeckShield, USDF & asUSDF by Halborn, asCAKE by Salus (2024-12-17).
References audits by Salus Security, PeckShield on AstherusVault, AsterEarn, asBNB, USDF, and asCAKE.

protocol_metadata.about: Aster USDF is a fully collateralized, yield-bearing stablecoin on BNB Chain minted 1:1 against USDT. Collateral is custodied by Ceffu and deployed in delta-neutral trading strategies (long spot + short perpetual positions) to generate consistent yield distributed weekly to asUSDF stakers. AsterEarn provides complementary yield-bearing liquid staking tokens (asBTC, asBNB, asCAKE) across the ecosystem.
